findings.label: Nullifying required fields on clear
findings.detail: ApplicationEditForm.update() uses `value || null`, which coerces any empty or whitespace string to null for required fields like parentFullName and childFirstName. The API receives null for non-nullable columns, risking a database error or silent data loss. Change the expression to `value` and handle nullable fields explicitly at each call-site.

findings.label: Screen-reader noise inside hamburger button
findings.detail: The three <span> bar elements inside the hamburger button in AdminShell.tsx lack aria-hidden="true". The button has an aria-label, but these spans are still announced by some screen readers as unlabeled inline content. Add aria-hidden="true" to each span.

findings.label: Missing key prop fix — verify in browser
findings.detail: Commit ffea694 fixed the AdminInquiriesTable key prop by moving it to <Fragment key={row.id}>. The current code looks correct, but the original error stack trace points here. Confirm the browser console is clean after the fix deployed — no code change needed, just a manual smoke-test.
